references.text: The original instruction to make the bronze basin and place it between the tent of meeting and the altar, where Aaron and his sons were to wash with water
The description of how the bronze basin was made with its bronze base
The fulfillment of this command, where Moses placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and filled it with water for washing
Moses anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, including the basin and its base
Solomon made ten bronze basins in the temple that served similar ritual purposes for washing
The Hebrews letter mentions various washings as part of the external regulations imposed until the new covenant
This is the direct fulfillment of the instruction in the source verse; together they show the completion of God's building plan.
The source verse is the practical execution of the specific instruction given here regarding placement and purpose.
This verse provides the theological necessity (life/death) behind the instruction to fill the basin with water in the source verse.
